items.title: Billy Bauer interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998
items.q: he’d tell me that the audition was Ned Wayburn “School Days.”

ctx.x: That’s right. What did your father do for a living?

He was a printer. He was really a song and dance man like I said, and he made, there was an audition — I wasn’t born about this time but he’d tell me that the audition was Ned Wayburn “School Days.” It got to be a big Broadway show. And they went up to Ossining, New York to break it in. And he made it as one of the guys in the cast, not the star. And as he went up to Ossining, which isn’t far from the Bronx, and his father told him if he could quit for show business was out. My grandfather, he thought that that…
No I want to hear this.
